scripts.test: bun run test:rust && bun run test:unit
scripts.test:unit: bun run --cwd apps/docs foldkit:build && vitest run --exclude '**/*.browser.test.*' --exclude '**/*.integration.test.*' --exclude '**/*.performance.test.*'
scripts.test:integration:browser: bun run test:integration:browser:packages && bun run test:integration:browser:docs
scripts.lint: oxlint -c tooling/oxc/base.json core shared runtime tooling scripts vitest.config.ts --deny-warnings
scripts.lint:docs: oxlint -c tooling/oxc/react.json apps/docs --deny-warnings && oxlint -c tooling/oxc/foldkit.json apps/docs/foldkit --deny-warnings
scripts.format: oxfmt -c tooling/oxc/oxfmt.json --write core shared runtime tooling scripts .github package.json nx.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.test.json konsistent.json apps/docs/package.json apps/docs/tsconfig.json apps/docs/vitest.browser.config.ts apps/docs/foldkit.vite.config.ts apps/docs/foldkit apps/docs/components apps/docs/lib apps/docs/__tests__ '!shared/pdf-core/__tests__/fixtures/*.md' '!**/.cache/**' '!**/node_modules/**' '!**/dist/**' '!**/*.d.ts' '!**/*.tsbuildinfo'
scripts.format:check: oxfmt -c tooling/oxc/oxfmt.json --check core shared runtime tooling scripts .github package.json nx.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.test.json konsistent.json apps/docs/package.json apps/docs/tsconfig.json apps/docs/vitest.browser.config.ts apps/docs/foldkit.vite.config.ts apps/docs/foldkit apps/docs/components apps/docs/lib apps/docs/__tests__ '!shared/pdf-core/__tests__/fixtures/*.md' '!**/.cache/**' '!**/node_modules/**' '!**/dist/**' '!**/*.d.ts' '!**/*.tsbuildinfo'
scripts.check:static: bun run check:declarative-errors && bun run lint && bun run lint:docs && bun run format:check
scripts.check:ts: bun run check:nx && bun run check:konsistent && bun run check:static && bun run typecheck && bun run typecheck:test && bun run typecheck:docs
scripts.check: bun run check:rust && bun run check:ts
